sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect only the information needed to provide Togthr's couple-wellness services: account email, encrypted password, profile details (nickname, avatar, anniversary date), and the content you create in the app (check-in answers, journal entries, time capsules, photos). We never sell your data to third parties.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Data
sections.body: Your data is used to: (a) sync content between you and your partner, (b) deliver push notifications and daily reminders you have opted into, (c) generate aggregated, anonymized insights, and (d) provide customer support when you contact us. We do not use your private content for advertising or AI training.

sections.heading: 3. Data Storage & Security
sections.body: All data is stored encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3) on Supabase and Cloudflare infrastructure. Time capsules remain end-to-end encrypted and cannot be read by Togthr staff. We perform quarterly security audits and notify affected users of any breach within 72 hours.

sections.heading: 4. Your Rights
sections.body: You can export, edit, or delete your data at any time from Settings > Privacy. Account deletion permanently removes all personal data within 30 days. You may also request a full data export by emailing privacy@togthr.life. EU and UK users have additional rights under GDPR, including data portability and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.heading: 5. Contact
sections.body: For any privacy-related question, email privacy@togthr.life. We respond within 7 business days.

sections.heading: 1. Eligibility
sections.body: You must be at least 16 years old (18 in some jurisdictions) to create a Togthr account. By signing up you confirm that you meet this requirement and that all information you provide is accurate.

sections.heading: 2. Account & Pairing
sections.body: Togthr works as a couple: you create a private pair by inviting your partner via email. Each pair shares a private space. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure. Sharing your account with non-parties is not permitted.

sections.heading: 3. Subscriptions & Payments
sections.body: We2 Plus subscriptions are billed via PayPal, Alipay, or Stripe. Prices are shown in your local currency. You can cancel at any time; access remains active until the end of the current billing period. Refunds follow the policy in section 4.

sections.heading: 4. Refund Policy
sections.body: If you are not satisfied within 14 days of your first Plus purchase, contact support@togthr.life for a full refund. Refunds are not available for renewals or for accounts that have violated these terms.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable Use
sections.body: You agree not to: upload illegal, hateful, or sexually explicit content; harass or threaten other users; attempt to reverse-engineer the app; use Togthr for commercial spam; or impersonate any person or entity. Violations may result in account suspension.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Togthr is provided 'as is' without warranties. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the past 12 months. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

sections.heading: 7. Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be announced by email at least 30 days in advance. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

cookies.title: Cookie-Richtlinie

sections.heading: 1. Essential Cookies
sections.body: These cookies are required for the site to work. They keep you logged in, remember your locale, and protect against CSRF attacks. They cannot be disabled because the site would not function without them.

sections.heading: 2. Analytics Cookies
sections.body: We use Cloudflare Web Analytics (privacy-first, no cross-site tracking) to understand which features are popular and where users get stuck. Analytics data is aggregated and does not identify you personally. You can opt out by enabling 'Do Not Track' in your browser.

sections.heading: 3. Payment Cookies
sections.body: When you complete a PayPal or Alipay payment, the payment provider may set its own cookies to process the transaction securely and prevent fraud. These cookies are governed by the payment provider's privacy policy, not ours.

sections.heading: 4. Managing Cookies
sections.body: You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings. Note that blocking essential cookies will prevent login from working. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies of any kind.
